plain_label: workers with earnings covered by Social Security
source_table_refs: 2026 OASDI Trustees Report, Overview / 2025 in Review
public_use_rule: Use only for rounded CY2025 Social Security covered-worker context. Do not use as a Medicare HI covered-worker count, taxpayer denominator, or exact administrative headcount.
notes: The 2026 OASDI Trustees Report states that during 2025 an estimated 185 million people paid payroll taxes on earnings covered by Social Security.

public_use_rule: Use only for rounded CY2025 OASDI beneficiary context. Do not use for Medicare, SSI, veterans, or non-Social-Security transfer denominators.
notes: The 2026 OASDI Trustees Report states that at the end of calendar year 2025 OASDI was providing monthly benefits to about 70.5 million people.

public_use_rule: Use only for rounded CY2025 Old-Age and Survivors Insurance beneficiary context.
notes: The 2026 OASDI Trustees Report states that at the end of calendar year 2025 OASI was providing benefits to about 62.3 million people.

public_use_rule: Use only for rounded CY2025 Disability Insurance beneficiary context.
notes: The 2026 OASDI Trustees Report states that at the end of calendar year 2025 DI was providing benefits to about 8.2 million people.
